login.title: Welcome back, player
login.subtitle: Sign in with the same account you use on Sai Server.

login.googleFailed: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.
login.ssoHint: Already signed in on Sai Server? You'll be signed in here automatically.

register.success: Account created. Please sign in to continue.

forgot.title: Reset your password

forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
forgot.failed: Could not send the reset link. Please try again.

home.subtitle: You're signed in to Sai Game.
home.resendFailed: Could not send the verification email.

games.title: Your games
games.emptyBody: Games you play with this account will show up here.

sgem.subtitle: Choose a package and a payment method.
sgem.discountTip: Want a better deal? Talk to Sai for exclusive discounts.

checkout.title: Bank Transfer Payment
checkout.subtitle: Scan the QR or transfer manually to complete payment.
checkout.redirectDesc: Click the button below if you are not redirected automatically.
checkout.warning: Enter the transfer note exactly as shown. Payments are matched by this code — if it is wrong, your payment will not be detected automatically.
checkout.successDesc: {amount} sGem has been added to your wallet.
checkout.failedDesc: The payment could not be processed. Please try again.
checkout.expiredDesc: This payment has expired. Please create a new one.
checkout.credit_failedDesc: We received your payment but could not credit your sGem yet. Please contact an admin.

directTransfer.title: Direct Transfer
directTransfer.subtitle: Transfer the exact amount to our account, then submit the form below.
directTransfer.notePlaceholder: Include your transfer reference number, bank name, or any other info to help us verify faster.
directTransfer.confirmLabel: I understand this is a manual bank transfer and I am ready to proceed.
directTransfer.transferredLabel: I have successfully transferred the money.
directTransfer.submitSuccess: Submitted! Our team will verify your transfer shortly.
directTransfer.submitSuccessDesc: You will receive a notification once the transfer is verified.
directTransfer.qrHint: Scan with MoMo or any banking app that supports VietQR.
